scope: Corollary 2.7 (Signs of controlled integers) of the manuscript “Existential–universal real sentences in the counting hierarchy” (preprints/Existential-universal-real-sentences-in-the-counting-hierarchy-October-4-2026/etr-counting-hierarchy.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 141 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 151fe6144a42154d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: If a controlled family has no indeterminates, its sign is available, uniformly in any short indices belonging to its input word.
